answer: With a Translation bundle passing automated tests backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The record keeps every nectar visible, so anyone can audit the work log. The velvet hides nothing and the island reveals everything: the review trail is open to all.
